abstract: OBJECTIVE: To study the long-term ovarian neoplastic consequences of resection of a dermoid cyst. METHODS: The study population comprised 99 patients who were operated on for an ovarian dermoid cyst. Follow-up information was obtained for 91 women for a mean period of 5.06 +/- 2.46 years. RESULTS: Of the 99 women, 18 had bilateral dermoid cysts. Multiple dermoid cysts in a single ovary were found in nine of the women with bilateral cysts and in one of the remaining patients. Two patients developed malignant germ cell tumors, and three developed a recurrent dermoid cyst in an ovary from which a dermoid cyst had previously been extracted. Bilateral or multiple ovarian dermoid cysts were present at the initial operation in four (80%) of these patients. CONCLUSIONS: Women with bilateral or multiple dermoid cysts may include a subgroup of patients with a greater tendency to develop future ovarian germ cell neoplasms.

目的：卵巣類皮嚢腫の切除後に生じる卵巣の腫瘍性合併症を長期的に検討すること。
方法：卵巣類皮嚢腫の手術を受けた99例を対象とした。91例について平均5.06±2.46年の追跡情報が得られた。
結果：99例中18例が両側類皮嚢腫であった。両側または多発性の症例のうち9例と、残りの1例では単一卵巣内に多発性の類皮嚢腫が認められた。2例が悪性胚細胞腫瘍を発症し、3例では以前に類皮嚢腫を摘出した卵巣に再発性の類皮嚢腫が生じた。これら5例のうち4例（80%）では、初回手術時に両側または多発性の卵巣類皮嚢腫が認められていた。
結論：両側または多発性の類皮嚢腫を有する女性には、将来卵巣胚細胞腫瘍を発症しやすい亜群が含まれている可能性がある。
